lifecycle: Delete all six catalog files after acceptance of the parent docs/JSON migration; retain only a compact revision/count/checksum summary if useful.

roots_and_selection.transitional_control_records: Every unique non-null record path in the selected chain task_sequence at the revision.

tool_identity.name: authority-catalog-python-stdlib
tool_identity.input_source: Git blobs at the exact revision
tool_identity.ordering: Unicode-code-point order of repository-relative paths and extracted triples
tool_identity.path_set_encoding: Each sorted repository-relative path encoded as UTF-8 followed by LF
tool_identity.reproduction_invocation: From the repository root, use git ls-tree -rz <revision> -- <root> for selection, git cat-file blob <oid> for bytes, and python/.venv/bin/python with only the standard library to apply rule_definitions in their listed order; serialize with json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus one trailing LF.

rule_definitions.file_kind_v1: Classify by lowercase final suffix: .md markdown, .rst restructuredtext, .json json, .py python, .toml toml, .yaml/.yml yaml, .txt text, .tex latex, .bib bibtex, .bbl latex_generated, .cls latex_class, .bst bibtex_style, .pdf pdf, .docx docx, .png/.jpg/.jpeg image, .svg svg, otherwise other.
rule_definitions.identity-only-v1: For file kinds pdf, docx, and image, retain identity and set parse_status=unsupported_binary without decoding or traversal.
rule_definitions.bounded-text-v1: For every other file kind, decode bytes with strict UTF-8. On UnicodeDecodeError retain identity and set parse_status=unsupported_binary; otherwise set parsed_utf8 before applying line rules.
rule_definitions.json-structure-v1: For a UTF-8 .json file, parse with json.loads. On JSONDecodeError set parse_failed_json. Otherwise set parsed_json and recursively visit dictionaries in insertion order and arrays by zero-based index while constructing RFC-6901-style pointers with ~ and / escaped as ~0 and ~1.
rule_definitions.declared-identifier-line-v1: Apply Python regex (?im)^(?:document_id|task_id|checkpoint_id|chain_id|Task identity)\s*:\s*`?([^`\n]+?)`?\s*$; strip capture 1 and select its one-based line.
rule_definitions.json-identifier-v1: During JSON recursion, retain a string value when its key is one of id, task_id, checkpoint_id, chain_id, episode_id, document_id, or parent; selector is the JSON pointer.
rule_definitions.markdown-link-v1: Apply Python regex \[[^\]]*\]\((?!https?://|mailto:|#)([^)]+)\); strip capture 1, discard a trailing fragment after #, and select its one-based line.
rule_definitions.wikilink-v1: Apply Python regex \[\[([^\]|#]+); strip capture 1 and select its one-based line.
rule_definitions.path-token-v1: Apply Python regex (?<![A-Za-z0-9_.-])(?:\.pi|docs|harness|python|specification)/[A-Za-z0-9_./$~*?-]+; retain the full match and one-based line.
rule_definitions.json-path-v1: During JSON recursion, retain a string containing / when its key is record, record_path, task_record, path, chain_path, or task_path; also retain any string beginning .pi/, docs/, harness/, python/, or specification/; selector is the JSON pointer.
rule_definitions.canonical_extractions_v1: Deduplicate each extraction family by the exact tuple (value, selector, rule_id), then sort tuples by Unicode code-point order.
rule_definitions.predecessor_v1: If current_path exactly matches a predecessor component path, emit same_component with sorted component IDs. Otherwise emit not_present_in_predecessor for docs/harness/, docs/development/agent-control-plane*, or .pi/ paths, and outside_predecessor_scope for other paths.
rule_definitions.residual_v1: Remove only paths listed in authority-mappings.json#/fully_mapped_paths after reviewed whole_file mapping; retain every partially mapped path.

predecessor.use: Provenance crosswalk only; it does not govern current lifecycle or authority.

claim_boundary: Complete path coverage is claimed only for the declared Git tree selection. Text extraction and semantic mappings are bounded and not repository-wide semantic completeness. Unsupported files remain visible.
